calibration_content_allowed: floor and ceiling annotation contents in Areas 1, 2, 3, 4, and 6 may be opened to develop room pairing, common-footprint crop, plane-quality, overlap, sampling, and deterministic split rules
candidate_method: unchanged Phase-50 shared quadratic trend fit, residual two-means, observed-only sampling gate, and one 2D Delaunay surface per layer
claim_boundary: this protocol permits leakage-controlled calibration on real floor--ceiling pairs but is not itself a real held-out result
dataset_name: Stanford Large-Scale Indoor Spaces 3D Dataset v1.2 aligned
final_preregistration_requirement: after calibration-only evaluation, commit exact plane, overlap, gap, point-count, crop, coordinate-hash split, metrics, gates, and Area-5 case enumeration before opening Area-5 contents
pair_definition_development: merge same-class annotation fragments within one calibration room, fit one robust plane per class, project to a shared tangent frame, and develop deterministic common-footprint and eligibility rules
pivot_reason: Phase-51A wall--board calibration had positive geometry margins but zero topology-safe accepts because opaque-board occlusion left non-overlapping wall support; floor and ceiling provide genuinely observed overlapping footprints
regime_boundary: floor--ceiling is an easier long-gap real two-layer regime; a positive result cannot be generalized to close wall--board layers, arbitrary surfaces, or scene-wide reconstruction
reserved_content_prohibition: before a separate final floor--ceiling protocol is committed, do not extract, open, parse, summarize, visualize, or compute any statistic from an Area-5 point-cloud member
runtime_information_boundary: candidate reconstruction and routing receive only combined observed XYZ coordinates; class, room, area, RGB, instance, and reference information cannot influence output
